targets.outcome_quote:
The overall pattern obtained in
Wave 1—two highly correlated domain-speciﬁc factors—was clearly replicated in Wave 2.
However, the more subtle eﬀects involving cross-domain loading were only partially
replicated and sometimes appeared unstable and context-speciﬁc.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors confirm the overall two-factor pattern but explicitly say cross-domain effects were only partially replicated. Study 2 extends the replication using additional measures in the new sample.
